verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page says it offers granular "package permissions — including container images and tags," which implies a first-party package and container registry. That is the only evidence: nothing documents publishing or consuming packages, or which formats are supported. Missing for 10: documented npm/PyPI/Maven format support, publish/consume workflows, public vs private package visibility, container registry docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
